title: GlobeXAI Current Fact Record (Phase 7)
description: A single current regulatory/trade fact. Every record MUST carry a live-fetched source URL and a real retrieval timestamp. A fact with no verifiable official source is recorded with status=UNSUPPORTED and a reason, never with a guessed value.

fact_type.description: Narrow machine-readable label within the category, e.g. MFN_APPLIED_AD_VALOREM, THIRD_COUNTRY_DUTY, TARIFF_PREFERENCE, RTA_IN_FORCE, PRODUCT_SPECIFIC_RULE, SCOMET_CONTROLLED, UN_COUNTRY_REGIME, EXPORT_POLICY_STATUS.

value.description: The fact's value. null when status is UNSUPPORTED or UNVERIFIED.

authority.description: The legal or statistical authority that publishes the fact (e.g. 'HM Revenue & Customs / UK Trade Tariff', 'DGFT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, India', 'World Trade Organization', 'UN Security Council').

source_url.description: The exact URL fetched. UNSUPPORTED records may carry the URL that was attempted, or the string 'NONE_FOUND'.

source_document.description: Citable document/dataset title, e.g. 'Appendix 3 - List of SCOMET Items', 'WTO RTA Database - AllRTAs export'.

retrieved_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the actual fetch that produced this record.

start.description: ISO 8601 date the measure took/takes legal effect. null = not published by the source.

end.description: ISO 8601 date the measure ceases. null = open-ended / not published.

jurisdiction.description: ISO3 code of the jurisdiction whose law/measure this is, or a bloc code (EUN, WLD) or 'UN'.

origin.description: ISO3 origin country of the goods, or null when the fact is not corridor-specific.

destination.description: ISO3 destination country, or null when not corridor-specific.

hs6.description: 6-digit HS code as a zero-padded string, or null when the fact is product-agnostic.

version.description: Source-declared version/edition/notification number, e.g. 'ORD v1.0 (13 January 2026)', 'ITC(HS) 2018 Schedule 2', 'AllRTAs export 2026-08-23'.

status.description: CURRENT = live-fetched from the authority and in force at retrieval_time. STALE = official but the source's newest available observation predates today's freshness policy. SUPERSEDED = replaced by a newer instrument. UNVERIFIED = obtained but not corroborated against the primary legal source. CONFLICT = two official sources disagree. UNSUPPORTED = no authoritative free source found; value is null and unsupported_reason is required.

unsupported_reason.description: REQUIRED when status=UNSUPPORTED. Plain-language reason, e.g. 'no free public source found', 'source requires subscription', 'HS6 not present in destination nomenclature'.

freshness_policy.description: How often this fact must be re-verified before reuse, e.g. 'REVERIFY_BEFORE_EVERY_DECISION', 'REVERIFY_DAILY', 'REVERIFY_QUARTERLY'.

verification_note.description: Caveats a downstream consumer must see: known amendment risk, aggregation caveats, scope limits.

raw.description: Verbatim fields as returned by the source, for audit.
